task: Would a simple 200-day trend filter have improved AAPL's risk and return versus buy-and-hold over 2016–2025?
context: AAPL vendor daily OHLC and corporate-action data; the feed does not verify exact regular-session or opening-auction prints.
Hold AAPL when its completed daily close is above its 200-session SMA, otherwise cash. Act at the next vendor daily open; keep the rule fixed.
Start with USD 1 million, no leverage or shorting, 10 bps each way, no additional slippage and zero cash interest. The comparator is gross dividend-inclusive buy-and-hold.

outputs.name: trader_conclusion
outputs.instructions: Write at most 120 words. State whether the fixed trend filter reduced drawdown and what return trade-off occurred, quoting computed figures. Mention next vendor-open execution, 10 bps each way, zero cash interest and the gross benchmark. Disclose that the daily feed's exact session/auction basis is not independently established. Do not imply that a successful run validates a trading edge. No Markdown table.
